definition.name: NXspm_scan_region
definition.doc:
The scan region is the area of phase space or sub-phase space where the scan is performed. The region could be N-dimensional and is defined by the minimum and maximum values of the scan axes.
Along each independent scan axis AXIS, the scan region is described either by the offset :math:`o` (``scan_offset_valueAXIS``) and the range :math:`r` (``scan_rangeAXIS``), or by the start :math:`s` (``scan_startAXIS``) and the end :math:`e` (``scan_endAXIS``). Either pair fully defines the scan region along that axis, with :math:`r = e - s`. Depending on the instrument, the offset refers either to the centre of the scan region or to its bottom-left corner (the point where the scan starts along each axis):
* centre offset: :math:`s = o - r/2` and :math:`e = o + r/2`. * corner offset: :math:`s = o` and :math:`e = o + r`; the centre of the scan region is at :math:`o + r/2`.
These relations hold along each axis of the scan frame, i.e. before the rotation by ``scan_angleAXIS`` is applied. In SPM, the centre-offset convention is the more common one.

field.name: scan_offset_valueAXIS
field.doc:
The offset of the scan region from the origin along the scan axis AXIS, referring either to the centre or to the bottom-left corner of the scan region (see the relations in the class description).
AXIS is the name of an independent scan axis (e.g. ``scan_offset_value_x``, ``scan_offset_value_voltage``).

field.name: scan_rangeAXIS
field.doc:
The range of the scan region along the scan axis AXIS, i.e. the difference between the end and the start of the scan (see the relations in the class description).
AXIS is the name of an independent scan axis (e.g. ``scan_range_x``, ``scan_range_voltage``).

field.name: scan_angleAXIS
field.doc:
The in-plane orientation of the scan region: the angle of the fast scan axis from the ``x`` axis of the scanner frame, as a rotation about ``z`` through the centre of the scan region. Positive angles follow the right-hand rule, i.e. they are counter-clockwise when viewed from the probe side looking down onto the sample surface.
AXIS denotes a lateral scan axis (e.g. ``scan_angle_x``). Both lateral scan axes are rotated by the same angle, so all instances must have the same value, and ``scan_angle_x`` alone is sufficient.

field.name: scan_startAXIS
field.doc:
The start of the scan region along the scan axis AXIS, i.e. the first value of AXIS in the scan (see the relations in the class description).
AXIS is the name of an independent scan axis (e.g. ``scan_start_x``, ``scan_start_voltage``).

field.name: scan_endAXIS
field.doc:
The end of the scan region along the scan axis AXIS, i.e. the last value of AXIS in the scan (see the relations in the class description).
AXIS is the name of an independent scan axis (e.g. ``scan_end_x``, ``scan_end_voltage``).

field.name: depends_on
field.doc: Places the scan frame (origin at the centre of the scan region, ``x`` along the fast scan axis, ``y`` along the slow scan axis) in the frame in which the scan offsets and the scan angle are given. Points to the transformation in :ref:`transformations </NXspm_scan_region/transformations-group>` that is applied first to a position in the scan frame.

group.name: transformations
group.doc: Translations and rotations that place the scan frame in its parent frame, typically the scan offset along each axis followed by the scan angle about ``z``.
